source: Real capture on the course dev machine by tools/vk-probe (binary pipeline-stats, `bun run sync:pipeline-stats`; ash at the course pin): a Vulkan 1.4 device on GPU 0 with VK_KHR_pipeline_executable_properties (pipelineExecutableInfo) and the Khronos validation layer; every pipeline is created with VK_PIPELINE_CREATE_CAPTURE_STATISTICS_BIT_KHR | VK_PIPELINE_CREATE_CAPTURE_INTERNAL_REPRESENTATIONS_BIT_KHR and read back with vkGetPipelineExecutablePropertiesKHR, vkGetPipelineExecutableStatisticsKHR and vkGetPipelineExecutableInternalRepresentationsKHR. Statistic names, descriptions and values are verbatim from the driver. `pressure`: GPU time (vkCmdWriteTimestamp2 at ALL_COMMANDS before and after) of one dispatch of `threads` invocations per kernel; runs alternate between kernels after one warm-up round; measured, not a benchmark.
